He was a musical innovator who was known for his eclectic work, flamboyant stage presence, extravagant dress and makeup, and wide vocal range.  His music integrates a wide variety of styles, including funk, rock, R&B, new wave, soul, psychedelia, and pop.  He has sold over 100 million records worldwide, making him one of the best-selling music artists of all time.
